2. PrioritiZe
We review issues and consider both the potential impact on stakeholder decisions and the impact on Intel’s business 
and external systems. We take into account factors of business continuity, impact to brand/reputation, applicability 
to multiple regions, alignment with Intel business strategies, impact on the community, ability to attract and retain 
talent, and regulatory implications. This year, we engaged a third party to moderate an online stakeholder input 
process to provide additional input into the issue prioritization process.
